title: Habit Bloom
summary: A gentle habit tracker where each habit grows a stem and daily check-ins add leaves — no streak shaming.

cover.alt: Today garden of Habit Bloom on warm fog paper: five habit rows, each habit a procedural SVG stem with alternating leaves beside serif habit names, mono field tags, leaf counts and dark pine check-in buttons.

desktop.alt: Habit Bloom on first visit at desktop size: an italic serif wordmark over Today/Insights navigation, with the storage opt-in banner above the first habit specimen rows.

tablet.alt: Habit Bloom at 1024x768: the storage banner and the first two specimen rows fill the narrower notebook column; stems, move buttons and check-in buttons keep their size.

mobile.alt: Habit Bloom on a 390px phone: each habit row stacks the stem with its leaf count and check-in button on top, the habit name and tags below, and drag plus move-up/move-down controls at the bottom.
